source: MMExplorer MDB direct Rooms-table direction columns
provenance_policy: Direct decoder evidence is promoted; missing prerequisites remain null/absent and are never invented.

semantic_enrichment.policy: proven authoritative; strongly correlated active with provenance; weak research-only; unknown preserved and fail-safe

edge_state_semantic_enrichment.policy: proven and strongly correlated behavior active; unknown preserved with safe fallback

action_latch_semantic_enrichment.policy: retain all evidence records but count unique semantic steps only
action_latch_semantic_enrichment.resolution_policy: native/passive effects are classified without invented player commands when MMExplorer and MegaMUD route replay do not provide command evidence

evaluation_semantics.range_bounds: inclusive when a range is explicit

state_impact.world_state_impact: trap, toll, door, hidden discovery, and cast effects may mutate transient or persisted world/player state
